summary: 两项“更快以太坊”的进展：barnabemonnot 宣布 quick slots（EIP-8198）作为特性规范并入以太坊共识规范；fradamt 发布面向 I* 的解耦共识协议形式化验证方案，目标是最终性快 4 到 8 倍。ethPandaOps 的 Hegotá frames-devnet-0 上线。Magicians 上开始讨论 EIP-8425，提议冻结并恢复未迁移到后量子方案的账户。

items.topic: 账户的后量子迁移与 frame 开发网
items.title: Magicians：EIP-8425 量子冻结与账户恢复
items.note: 00:19（colinlyguo）。延续“量子恢复路径”的讨论，问是否该为冻结和恢复未迁移账户写 EIP，例如基于 Vitalik 的量子紧急恢复提案；提前在各客户端准备和测试实现能缩短应急时间。一个担忧是：已通过签名暴露公钥但所有者已失去访问的账户无法迁移，资金可能落入量子攻击者手中。
items.title_en: Magicians: EIP-8425 quantum freeze and account recovery
items.note_en: 00:19 (colinlyguo). Continuing the "quantum recovery pathway" discussion, it asks whether there should be an EIP for freezing and recovering unmigrated accounts, for example building on Vitalik's quantum emergency recovery proposal; preparing and testing implementations across clients in advance could shorten emergency response time. One concern: accounts whose public keys were exposed through signatures but whose owners have lost access cannot migrate, and their funds could fall to quantum attackers.

summary_en: Two "faster Ethereum" milestones: barnabemonnot announced that quick slots (EIP-8198) was merged as a feature spec into the Ethereum consensus specs, and fradamt released a formally verified proposal for a decoupled consensus protocol in I*, targeting 4 to 8 times faster finality. ethPandaOps launched the Hegotá frames-devnet-0. Magicians began discussing EIP-8425, which would freeze and recover accounts that have not migrated to post-quantum schemes.
